title: Multimodal RewardBench 2: Evaluating Omni Reward Models for Interleaved Text and Image

layout.note: Four rounded tinted cards in two columns of unequal height: text-to-image over interleaved generation on the left, image editing over multimodal reasoning on the right. Pink and blue alternate diagonally. Every card stacks title, prompt with its input photos, two captioned candidates and two verdict lines.

lesson: A uniform card anatomy (title, prompt with its input images, two captioned candidates, icon-led verdict lines) lets one figure cover four unlike task types and makes human and model judgments comparable. Elide long outputs with [...] and [IMAGE].
